summary: Semnur Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting termination of two material definitive agreements: (1) a PIPE Securities Purchase Agreement with JW Capital Securities Limited for 1,250,000 shares at $16/share, and (2) a Securities Purchase Agreement with Biconomy PTE. Ltd for 6,250,000 shares at $16/share payable in Bitcoin. Both were terminated via notice under Section 8 effective April 20, 2026. No shares were ever issued under either agreement. The company was formed via a deSPAC business combination in September 2025. Termination removes committed capital, creating uncertainty about future financing. Watch for alternative funding announcements or potential cash constraints.
